'''Benkudi''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who operated in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He had worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and for [[Human/Legends|Human]] aspiring [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kaeline Ungasan]]. He was also a casual friend of [[Ree]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] working for the Hutts.

==Biography==
At some point, [[Ree]] left the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and began working for [[Kaeline Ungasan|Ungasan]] in a plot involving a new [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] event in [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], the [[Ungasan Cross Country]]. Ungasan changed the course every [[Time/Legends|time]] it was raced, supposedly to provide new and exciting challenges; there was a secret reason, but Benkudi did not know it. Nevertheless, being an opportunistic informer, Benkudi wanted to sell anything he knew to the Hutts.<ref name="G2" />

However, at this point, the Hutts were already aware of Ungasan's podracing activities. They used one of their employees, [[Jer Blankuna]], to hire independent agents to find Ree. Blankuna pretended to be Ree's worried father, and he falsely claimed to have been contacted by Benkudi. The agents followed this trail. Ree, who was familiar with Benkudi's traits, advised Ungasan to silence him. Ungasan in turn sent four contract workers of the CSA with [[Vibrodagger/Legends|vibrodaggers]] to beat Benkudi up. Nevertheless, Benkudi told the independent agents everything he knew, and some things he believed&mdash;like Ungasan being a former [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] for the Hutts.<ref name="G2" />
